title.en: I have / I don't have + partitive

summary: Twenty sentences about family (siblings, children, partners, cousins) and masks to translate into Finnish with minulla on / minulla ei ole and the partitive, plus a short vocabulary list.
transcript:
MINULLA ON / MINULLA EI OLE + -A
Kuinka sinä sanot suomeksi:
1. I have two sisters.
2. I don’t have a sister but I have a brother.
3. I don’t have a brother.
4. How many siblings do you have?
5. I don’t have a big family.
6. How many children do you (plural ”you”) have?
7. We have three children: two girls and one boy.
8. Do you have any children?
9. No, but we have two dogs.
10. Stuart has a Finnish boyfriend.
11. I have a Finnish girlfriend.
12. She doesn’t have a husband. She is not married.
13. I have a Finnish mother.
14. How many cousins does Teija have?
15. Does your Father have a brother?
16. Susanna has two brothers.
17. Her sister has three children: one boy and two small girls.
18. Susanna’s boyfriend has two daughters.
19. Do you have a mask ”on” you?
20. She has two dirty masks but not a clean mask.
SANASTO: brother=veli (any ending added to ”velje-”) how many= kuinka monta (”monta” is like a number so followed by partitive) sibling=sisarus family=perhe any children= lapsia but= mutta husband=(avio)mies (endings added to ”miehe-” cousin= serkku small= pieni mask= maski ”on you”= mukana dirty= likainen clean= puhdas

words.note: followed by partitive, like a number
partitive sg lasta, pl lapsia (any children)

exercises.title: Kuinka sinä sanot suomeksi
exercises.instruction: How do you say in Finnish (minulla on / minulla ei ole + partitive).

items.prompt: I have two sisters.
I don't have a sister but I have a brother.
items.answer: Minulla ei ole siskoa, mutta minulla on veli.

items.prompt: I don't have a brother.
How many siblings do you have?
I don't have a big family.
How many children do you (plural "you") have?
We have three children: two girls and one boy.
items.answer: Meillä on kolme lasta: kaksi tyttöä ja yksi poika.

items.prompt: Do you have any children?
No, but we have two dogs.
items.answer: Ei, mutta meillä on kaksi koiraa.

items.prompt: Stuart has a Finnish boyfriend.
I have a Finnish girlfriend.
She doesn't have a husband. She is not married.
items.answer: Hänellä ei ole miestä. Hän ei ole naimisissa.

items.prompt: I have a Finnish mother.
How many cousins does Teija have?
Does your Father have a brother?
Susanna has two brothers.
Her sister has three children: one boy and two small girls.
items.answer: Hänen siskollaan on kolme lasta: yksi poika ja kaksi pientä tyttöä.

items.prompt: Susanna's boyfriend has two daughters.
Do you have a mask "on" you?
She has two dirty masks but not a clean mask.
items.answer: Hänellä on kaksi likaista maskia, mutta ei puhdasta maskia.

grammar_notes.heading: MINULLA ON / MINULLA EI OLE + -A
grammar_notes.text: Possession with adessive + on; in the negative (minulla ei ole) and after numbers / kuinka monta the noun takes the partitive (-a/-ä).
